image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), perched on a thin, leafless branch against a clear blue sky. The bird displays breeding male plumage characteristics: a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast and underparts, and black upperparts with distinct white shoulder patches and wing bars. The bill is short, conical, and yellowish-grey. The legs are pinkish-brown, gripping the branch firmly.
